descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
Own your future 
 Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.
 Must-Haves 
5+ years of professional experience in frontend development, with production React work throughout.
Strong proficiency in TypeScript and extensive experience building complex web applications with React.js (React 19).
Hands-on experience with Vite, npm packaging, and dependency management, including upgrading and absorbing breaking changes.
Deep experience consuming design systems: tokens, theming, and component composition.
Experience with React Router and deep linking.
Strong skills in mobile-accurate responsive CSS and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA).
Experience with GitHub Copilot or similar AI coding tools.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner directly with designers and gather requirements through conversation rather than written specs.
A proactive, self-directed mindset: able to drive discovery independently, make sound product calls on prototype fidelity, and work effectively as a team of one.
Upper-intermediate+ level of English.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with API mocking (MSW) and client state management (Zustand); ability to read Redux.
Familiarity with Figma Dev Mode, Code Connect, or MCP design-to-code tooling. 
Ability to read back-end code for integration.
Familiarity with static deployments and CI pipelines.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, build, and own runnable React sandbox environments that replicate applications using mocked data and no backend.
Build end-to-end user flows from design system components.
Validate and maintain Figma integration so designer-generated code runs in the sandbox unmodified.
Collaborate closely with designers, the design system team, and product engineering to translate real application behavior into accurate prototypes.
Conduct code reviews of product team contributions against design system standards.
Write clear documentation and context files for designers, engineers, and AI agents working in the repo.
